verdict.rationale: Docs show you can connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription so cubic uses those models for local reviews, giving some provider choice (cubic-docs-14). However, this is scoped to local CLI reviews only, not a general per-session model picker across the whole product (PR reviews, chat, wiki, etc.), and there's no evidence of switching models within a single session or a full list of supported providers. Missing for 10: session-level model switching UI, full list of supported providers, evidence this applies beyond local CLI reviews.
